Title: Coordinated Control of Industrial Processes and Power Systems for Resiliency of Operation
Biography: Maiken Omtveit is a industrial PhD candidate in Electrical Engineering with ABB and the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU). Maiken holds an MSc in Electrical Engineering from NTNU, where she in her master thesis worked on an algorithm for detection of active electromechanical modes in the Nordic power system. Her broader research ambition is to develop general modelling and control frameworks that enable flexible operation of industrial energy systems, supporting the integration of renewable energy, improving system resilience, and accelerating industrial decarbonisation.

Title: Reinforcement learning for control and optimization in energy systems
Biography: My name is Juan, and I am a PhD candidate in Chemical Engineering at KAUST in Saudi Arabia. My research focuses on applying and deploying data-driven methods in energy systems. During my doctoral studies,  I have worked on combustion control and hydrogen production, and my goal is to improve the control of highly nonlinear systems using learning-based methods such as reinforcement learning.
